reviews.title: Yes, finally! Shortcuts!
reviews.text: Huge game-changer with the addition of the Shortcut actions. Most habits require only a simple press on the widget or on my watch, but a few of them, like adding time spent listening to audiobooks, require me to look at my BookPlayer widget and then move back and forth between the Habit app and the audiobook widget to enter the times. My audiobook app only shows stats for the last 7 days and only provides them through its widget. If I don’t manually copy down the times every week, I completely lose the stats for those days. Now, with the added actions for the Habit app, I can simply press an icon that runs a Shortcut I’ve built. It moves to the screen with the audiobook widget, takes a screenshot, extracts the data, parses it, and sends it directly into the habit tracker for me. This removes a TON of the tedious work! This developer creates wonderful apps, but they’re often in desperate need of Shortcut actions. When they do have some, they’re usually pretty limited. So I was super excited to see this update! Would love an action that could start the stopwatch/timer built into Habit! Pressing the Habit widget is ALMOST there, but it doesn’t actually start or stop the time itself. Same goes for the Live Activity; it takes you to the page but requires you to manually start the timer. This really isn’t a huge deal and doesn’t take any of the 5 stars away. Thought I’d just suggest it ;) (The watch app could use the ability to start the timer as well!) Thank you again for the actions! :D
